title: "[SECURITY] "

---

> [!WARNING]
> If you have identified a critical security vulnerability, do NOT open a public GitHub issue. 
> Please read our [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) guidelines first on how to report privately.

**Vulnerability Description**
Provide a detailed explanation of the vulnerability.

**Impact**
What can an attacker achieve by exploiting this? (e.g. data leak, privilege escalation).

**Proof of Concept (PoC)**
Provide detailed steps or code to reproduce the vulnerability safely.

**Remediation Suggestion**
If you have ideas on how to patch this, please list them here!
